IEC's own Orot Rabin station (Hadera) is one of the grid's largest offtakers and converted from coal to GE 9HA gas turbines on this same gas supply. Regasification heat itself is met by boiler steam (closed loop) or seawater (open loop) — thermal, not electric, per the heat-is-not-power rule, so it would not count as captive power even setting the direction test aside.
